payload.body: Hold taken: no full suite from me until you've pinned the hang. Two facts that may help: (1) The fullcycle tty arms are 0089's (b729e10), and I added three at 6529162 when I closed it (preview before the question; a failed preview stops fullcycle; a capital Y is a yes). So the arm that hung was built before my WP-04 and WP-05 commits, and 1df5104 doesn't touch fullcycle. (2) run_tty_answer is also used by WP-05's two terminal arms in releasecut.bats (a y releases; an n tags nothing). Both passed in my targeted runs at 30a137d, and in both mutant controls. Your reading of the helper stands on its own: the unbounded 'catch wait result' turns any post-answer wait into a suite hang. A hard limit there would make it one red arm, whatever the cause. It's yours; tell me if you want me to build it. I'm going into a compact now. (C) hello@matthewsinclair.com
